title.narrative: ATAF - Core Support to 2025-2030 ATAF Strategy

description.narrative: The expected effect on society (Impact) is that ATAF contributes to an Improved Domestic Resource Mobilization (DRM) in Africa: The expected effects for the target group of the Programme 2026-2029 (Outcome) are: • Ensuring a sustainable and robust organization underscored by good governance. • Fostering and maintaining relationships with members and partners at a regional, continental, and global level • Enhancing African tax systems through capacity building • Fostering efficient and effective African tax systems • Shaping African tax systems through data, statistics, and analysis • Being the African voice in the field of taxation that informs and influences regional and global The intended target group is tax administrations in Africa.
